CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_task_answer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_task_answer(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    cycle integer NOT NULL CHECK (cycle > 0),
    context_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    learning_targets jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    opened_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    closed_at timestamptz NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (student_task_answer_id, cycle),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (btrim(context_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(learning_targets) = 'array'),
    CHECK (jsonb_array_length(learning_targets) <= 100),
    CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= opened_at)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action_active_answer_idx
    ON student_learning_action(student_task_answer_id)
    WHERE closed_at IS NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_action_student_opened_idx
    ON student_learning_action(student_id, opened_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_outbox (
    event_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    subject varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    correlation_id varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id varchar(128) NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    locked_by varchar(128) NULL,
    locked_until timestamptz NULL,
    published_at timestamptz NULL,
    last_error varchar(2000) NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CHECK (btrim(subject) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(correlation_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'event_id' = event_id::text),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'event_type' = subject),
    CHECK ((payload ->> 'schema_version')::integer = schema_version),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'student_id' = student_id::text),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'correlation_id' = correlation_id),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'causation_id' = COALESCE(causation_id, '')),
    CHECK ((locked_by IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS student_outbox_pending_idx
    ON student_outbox(next_attempt_at, occurred_at)
    WHERE published_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_evidence
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_evidence_observation_index_check;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_evidence
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_evidence_observation_index_check
    CHECK (observation_index BETWEEN 0 AND 299);

INSERT INTO student_learning_action (
    id,
    student_task_answer_id,
    student_id,
    task_id,
    cycle,
    context_type,
    context_id,
    learning_targets,
    opened_at,
    created_at
)
SELECT
    uuid_generate_v4(),
    answer.id,
    answer.student_id,
    answer.task_id,
    1,
    'lesson_task',
    answer.task_id::text,
    '[]'::jsonb,
    answer.started_at,
    answer.created_at
FROM student_task_answer AS answer
WHERE answer.status IN (1, 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM student_learning_action AS action
      WHERE action.student_task_answer_id = answer.id
  );
